text:
- Registry: crates/nmp-app-chirp/concept-reads.json (iOS, facade=ChirpApp) and crates/nmp-chirp-android-ffi/concept-reads.json (Android, facade=AppHandle), both declaring replies/reactions/reposts (no zaps).
- iOS: ran `nmp gen concept-reads --platform rust` (generates crates/nmp-app-chirp/src/concept_reads_generated.rs, a `#[uniffi::export] impl ChirpApp` slice) and `--platform swift` (Bridge/Generated/ConceptReads.generated.swift). Had to hand-patch one generated import line (`crate::facade::ChirpApp` → `crate::app::ChirpApp` — Chirp's facade lives in app.rs, not facade.rs). Added a hand-written generic `ChirpApp.findTypedProjectionPayload(frame:key:)` since concept reads ride the same generic push frame as everything else, not a separate transport. `Components/NoteSocialCounts.swift` claims the 3 reads per row via `.task(id: item.id)`, decodes on every pushed frame via a new `KernelHandle.conceptReadFrameReceived` Combine subject, releases on `.onDisappear`.
